elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Standard workspace access requests are typically processed within 2-3 business days. Admin-level access requires additional security review and may take up to 5 business days. Requests submitted on Fridays or before holidays may experience slight delays.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Make sure you know the exact workspace name - misspellings will delay your request
  • If requesting for a team, include all team member email addresses in the justification field
  • Read-only access is usually approved faster than write/admin access
  • You must have completed Fundamentals training before admin access will be granted
  • Workspace access is tied to your corporate email - make sure you're using the correct account
